content: Nsyääl ntɔn aŋàlàkwikilà
Twon aŋän a ngwal baal aŋànün, wɛɛ un'lɛɛl asànaa taaràŋà. Awɛl atö asànaa atɔŋ,
andweer akaar asànaa bàmaa, asyee asànaa ampääŋ, unsà mpem aŋàbwaŋ.
Asyäŋà akweel adim, akweel adim abà bàndandaa aŋàyen.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa un'kweel un'dim mwɛy we anà baan itàkal atil, wɛy ba bàtwab atàlɔŋkà musyääl làkwikilà aba u ndwà aba ŋakwo anà mufuur ibay akà aböör aba. Awà undiir ufàkyey Nzam.
Un'kweel un'dim a ndandaa awà aŋàyen, afàsà làkyän ande amu Nzam. Nde afàsin aküünà u ndɔ̈ɔ̈m anà u ngyamàkà mpib anà mwäänà.
Wɛɛ, wunà akwà afàsyääl ilään a ndür, nde wàŋàkwà itaan, itàkal naa nde wà anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Le indiir atsuŋ ngye ba, ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n apɛl.
Isàkal naa mbuur ufàbay anki atɔŋ ande, sin sin baar a ndwà ande, nde kan'kɔɔb làkwikilà ande, nde kan'söön mbuur akɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà unsà ube.
Musɔn ikɔb a un'kaar unsà itsuŋ a akweel adim, nde akal àŋàkölà mbul an'kwem an'syaam, anà kàkäl un'kyay a un'dim mwɛy mpɛl.

Wɛy nde ukäl un'kaar awà bàyöb isal ande byà ntsà: kàbɔɔŋ baan ande ubwaŋàbwaŋ, kàfawalà baar u ndwà ande, kàfaywɛyà in'kɔl a aŋàlàkwikilà, kàbayà aŋangyɛb anà kàfakyerà undiir wanswà wàŋàbwaŋ.
Wɛɛ akà akweel adim abà asyee, twon an'kyey mukasɔn. Ntɔn, umpal ifàsɛnà ilään a ndür aba, ya ifasiinà mufàbääl, waa bàkɔɔb Klistɔ,
abun, ba ban'bwà unsà ikwàndwà ntɔn ban'bɛy ba kyään aba làtàtwɛb.
Apan sye, ntɔn ubwal, ba bàfàlɔŋkà muyikyà ndwà a ndwà. Yan'söön ube, ba kà nà abwal mpɛl anki, wɛɛ sye baar a itetɛɛn anà bà mun ipɔl.
Abun, mɛ in'kwen naa akweel adim abà asyee bàtɛ bɔr, bàbör baan, bàyaal ndwà aba anà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n apà abör mbwo atwee.
Ntɔn amwɛy amu ba bàfuràtàdiimà mbwo ntɔn mulab Satanà.
Isàkal naa ŋàlàkwikilà mwɛy we anà akweel adim u ywar ande, wɛy nde kabay, waa buur bàkɔɔn akal udu a Ikööŋ, ntɔn Ikööŋ ikwe mubay akweel adim abà ndandaa aŋàyen.
Andweer bàfàler Ikööŋ ubwaŋàbwaŋ ban'kwo muwal nsyäŋà mbalà yweel, sin sin ba akwà bàfàwal buur a kölàköl unsà Ndaa anà an'lɔɔŋ.
Abun, Ndaa Aŋàsɔn itɛɛnà naa: « Twon an'bäm mun a ngɔɔmà utaaŋ undyarà wa mbɛŋ » anà: « Un'syääl an'kwo muwal làfur ande. »
Twon an'kyey mfüün ntɔn un'dweer ukɔɔn imbäl a baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l itàkal atär.
Baar ban'kyer man'be, aŋän u mii a baar banswà, ntɔn bumwɛy sye bàmɛn bɔɔmà.
Mɛ amalɔɔm umii a Nzam, u mii a Klistɔ Yɛsu anà u mii a akyeey in'kyɛɛl: lab indiir abi ukɔɔn nkyɛɛr anà ukɔɔn un'kɔl aŋàyɔŋ.
Twon an'düül musà mbuur an'kɔɔ, twon an'bilà unsà man'be a mbuur asin. Ngye ŋakwo kal wàŋàpöŋà.
Wɛy munwà an'dà mpɛl, wɛɛ nwà sye ndam a man, ntɔn kwiy angye anà an'kyal angye taaŋ lanswà.
Man'be a baar amwɛy màfàmɛnà kusà mutsul mbar, wɛɛ akà bumwɛy, ma màfàmɛnà ungöngö.
Abun sye, isal a ntsà byàkyer afàmɛnà, itàkal bya akwà mpa byàfàmɛnà agyä byàkwo anki musin akalà byàŋàyee.
